title: Region
description: Geographic region or area within a country with name, country association, description, and area measurements. Used for administrative divisions, geographic classification, and regional data.

name.description: Name of the region (e.g., California, Bavaria, Tuscany)

country.description: Country where this region is located

description.description: Description of the region's characteristics, geography, or significance

area.description: Total area of the region in square kilometers
